meta.name: pytorch-rocm-half-gpu
meta.description: PyTorch on ROCm / half an AMD GPU, pool amd; logs the GPU, its share and 5 min of fp16 compute (oif)

spec.args: -u -c "import os, time, torch; c = torch.cuda; f = float(os.environ.get('OIF_GPU_MEMORY_FRACTION', '1')); total = c.mem_get_info()[1]; print('GPU', c.get_device_name(0), os.environ.get('OIF_GPU_PCI'), '| share', f, '| GPU memory %.1f GiB, this pod may use %.1f GiB' % (total / 2**30, f * total / 2**30)); a = torch.randn(8192, 8192, device='cuda', dtype=torch.float16); t = time.time(); n = sum(1 for _ in iter(lambda: (a @ a).sum().item() if time.time() - t < 300 else None, None)); print('fp16 matmul over 5 min: %.1f TFLOPS' % (n * 2 * 8192**3 / (time.time() - t) / 1e12))"
